items.title: Return CRS tax residency self-certification form
items.quote: Please complete the enclosed self-certification form and send it back to us by 29 October 2025.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date as the deadline ('by 29 October 2025'), so no period calculation is needed. This is a private deadline set by a company (bank), not an authority, so the statutory delivery-fiction rules and § 108 AO/§ 31 VwVfG do not apply; the date is taken as written. 29 October 2025 falls on a Wednesday (not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW), so no weekend/holiday shift under § 193 BGB is required. Final day: 29 October 2025.
